readerCopy.body: Anger may arrive at the exact place where you were taught not to take up space. When Mars conjuncts Chiron, the need to act, object, compete, or defend yourself can collide with an older reflex to apologize for having force at all. A clear no may come out and then get softened immediately, or frustration may build until the response is much bigger than the request required. Use the anger to identify the boundary. You do not need to erase the boundary just because stating it made you uncomfortable.
